-- Phase 2: bodies implemented. Declarations and contracts are unchanged.

-- True when `name` is a single plain file name: no path separators,
-- no "." or ".." components, so it cannot leave the `notes` directory.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  pre name.char_count() > 0
  ex safe_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Reads one file through the capability in scope; None when it cannot be read.
try_read(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  fs.read(name) else None

-- Returns the text of the first readable file among `names` inside `notes`,
-- or "" when none can be read. Names that are not safe_name are skipped.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if safe_name(name)
        let t = try_read(name)
        if t != None
          return t else ""
  ""
